GRADE 3 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Multiplication at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Multiplication using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Multiplication completely.
   C. Multiplication is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Multiplication.

2. About Multiplication using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Multiplication at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Multiplication completely.
   C. Multiplication is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Multiplication.

3. About Multiplication when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Multiplication helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Multiplication completely.
   C. Multiplication is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Multiplication.

5. About Division at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Division using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Division completely.
   C. Division is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Division.

6. About Division using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Division at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Division completely.
   C. Division is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Division.

7. About Division when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Division helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Division completely.
   C. Division is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Division.

9. About Length at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. measure length in metres, record their results. metre stick?
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

10. About Length using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. measure length in metres, record their results. metre stick?
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

11. About Length when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. measure length in metres, record their results. metre stick?
   B. Learners should ignore Length completely.
   C. Length is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Length.

13. About Mass at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. measure mass in kilograms,  Learners to make masses of 1kg using sand/ beam balance?
   B. Learners should ignore Mass completely.
   C. Mass is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mass.

14. About Mass using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. measure mass in kilograms,  Learners to make masses of 1kg using sand/ beam balance?
   B. Learners should ignore Mass completely.
   C. Mass is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mass.

15. About Mass when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. measure mass in kilograms,  Learners to make masses of 1kg using sand/ beam balance?
   B. Learners should ignore Mass completely.
   C. Mass is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Mass.

17. About Capacity at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. measure capacity in litres,  Learners to add and subtract capacity in
   B. Learners should ignore Capacity completely.
   C. Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Capacity.

18. About Capacity using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. measure capacity in litres,  Learners to add and subtract capacity in
   B. Learners should ignore Capacity completely.
   C. Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Capacity.

19. About Capacity when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. measure capacity in litres,  Learners to add and subtract capacity in
   B. Learners should ignore Capacity completely.
   C. Capacity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Capacity.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Multiplication at the market in your county.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Division at the market in your county.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Length at the market in your county.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Mass at the market in your county.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Capacity at the market in your county.
